claim: 把Notebook导出为静态HTML或PDF，可以帮助他人阅读，但仅此不足以让他人执行原计算。

evidence.original_text: At the very least, leave static HTML/PDF versions of all notebooks stored in the final version of the repository accompanying a publication. If, in 20 years, all other execution technology fails, these are likely to still provide a readable archival record, and with a full dependences list, future users are more likely to be able to recreate the compute environment.

reason: 文档指出静态HTML/PDF版本可作为可读的存档记录，但仅此不足以让他人执行原计算，还需要依赖列表和可执行环境（如Binder、Docker等）来支持运行。
